###### Title
Gradient

###### Definition
A "Gradient" defines multiple applications. In it's most classical term, the "Gradient" is a smooth blend between Two or more Colors [[117]]

###### Image
![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/9/91/Vector_Field_of_a_Function%27s_Gradient_imposed_over_a_Color_Plot_of_that_Function.svg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=index&utm_content=original)

###### Disambigioation
However, Metaphorically [[37]] the Gradient may be defined by it's Functional [[40]] aspect of "A smooth blending between things."

The Antonym [[118]] of a Gradient is a "Stepped" or "Stop"
